essence: The verse introduces the installation rite by announcing its declared characteristic to the twice-born.
The retinue pavilion is to be carried out according to the prescribed method.
The jewel deposit rite is required for both stone-born and metal-born images.
After installation, eye-opening, purification, and circumambulation are performed for villages and similar places.
Either feeding the twice-born or sprinkling sacred water may be performed.
